candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe hard. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear wahala. E no get fever. E no dey convulse now. E never get convulsion before. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. I count the pikin breath for one full minute. As I dey check am, pikin calm. I use pulse oximeter check am, e dey available. Oxygen for blood na 89.9 percent. I count 35 breaths per minute. E no get chest indrawing. E no get stridor when e calm. E no dey wheeze and e never get recurrent wheeze.
